'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***Israeli forces kill at least 71 [[Palestinian]]s in the [[Gaza Strip]]. At least 14 of those Palestinians are killed in [[North Gaza Governorate|North Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/26/live-israel-kills-over-80-in-gaza-3-killed-in-israeli-settler-attack (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli settler violence]]
***Three [[Palestinians]] are killed and many others are injured by [[Israeli settlements|Israeli settlers]] in the village of [[Kafr Malik]] near [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz9knl5w529o/ (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 South Africa floods]]
**The death toll from the flooding caused by a [[winter storm]] in the [[Eastern Cape]] of [[South Africa]] two weeks earlier increases to 101, with two children still missing. [https://apnews.com/article/flooding-south-africa-weather-9e1f7c718660dda47a59c97129f5def3 (AP)]
*Nine people are killed and thousands of others are [[Internally displaced person|displaced from their homes]] amid [[torrential rain]] and [[flash flood]]s in [[Rongjiang County]], [[Guizhou]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-floods-rains-a62d74ea16a391b9bd9ca37638ff0b69 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/26/six-dead-thousands-displaced-as-floods-hit-southwestern-china (Al Jazeera)]
*Three people are killed and dozens of others are missing in a flash flood caused by torrential rain in [[Kangra, Himachal Pradesh|Kangra]], [[Himachal Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-floods-himachal-pradesh-dharamshala-915df7c630e2b35a23886215d448b60e (AP)]
*The bodies of three missing people are recovered after the June 20 crash of an Airmedic [[MBB/Kawasaki BK 117]] in a lake shortly after takeoff from [[Havre Saint-Pierre Airport]] in [[Quebec]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/article/bodies-of-three-people-missing-after-airmedic-helicopter-crash-in-quebec-recovered/ (CTV News)]
*Two people are killed, including a child, and 17 others are injured, including one critically, during torrential storms causing [[flooding]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/storms-in-france-leave-2-dead-17-injured-and-cause-parliament-to-spring-a-leak/ (CTV News)]
*A [[double-decker bus]] carrying students from [[Barton Peveril Sixth Form College]] plunges into a river in [[Eastleigh]], [[Hampshire]], [[England]], injuring all 19 passengers, including five who are hospitalized. [https://apnews.com/article/doubledecker-bus-river-england-students-injured-eastleigh-9780be57bca126148abde8f31587b71d (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*A [[United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime]] report says the worldwide [[Recreational drug use|recreational use]] and production of [[cocaine]] hit an all-time high in 2023, saying the current surge in cocaine use is primarily due to increased illicit [[coca|coca bush]] cultivation in [[Colombia]] and updated yield data. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2025/0626/1520402-cocaine-un-report/ (RTÉ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**[[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian president]] [[Daniel Noboa]] announces the recapture of [[José Adolfo Macías Villamar]], the leader of the [[Los Choneros]] cartel and [[Ecuador]]'s most wanted criminal, in [[Manta, Ecuador|Manta]], [[Manabí Province]], after he disappeared from a prison last year. [https://www.dw.com/en/ecuadors-most-wanted-gang-leader-fito-arrested-president/a-73043249 (DW)]
*[[Anti–money laundering#United States|Anti–money laundering § United States]], [[War on drugs#Mexico|War on drugs § Mexico]]
**The [[Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores]] temporarily takes over the management of CIBanco, Intercam Banco, and Vector Casa de Bolsa following allegations of [[money laundering]] for [[Mexican drug war|drug cartels]]. [https://elpais.com/mexico/2025-06-26/la-comision-nacional-bancaria-y-de-valores-interviene-temporalmente-a-cibanco-y-a-intercam.html (El País)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests against Faure Gnassingbé]]
**Clashes take place between protesters and security forces in the [[Togo]]lese capital [[Lomé]] amid calls for [[Faure Gnassingbé]], who has ruled the country since 2005, to step down. Opposition groups accuse Gnassingbé of changing [[Constitution of Togo|the constitution]] to remain in office indefinitely. [https://apnews.com/article/togo-protest-gnassingbe-ce115db23e8a2722ae1e23886326198e (AP)]
